title: Summit Upgrade Member Rates for Paid Upgrades into First
content:
**Crestline Summit Loyalty Program benefit terms for paid upgrades into First on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The First upgrade price is multiplied by the **upgrade member rate**, which follows the membership the ticket credits and the member's Summit flight accruals dated within the last 12 months. The rate acts on the unrounded price; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

| Summit membership the ticket credits | Flight accruals in the last 12 months | Upgrade member rate |
|---|---|---|
| Active, upgrade priority rank four or better (rank one, two, three or four) | 8 or more (top member flight count) | 0.8 |
| Active, upgrade priority rank five | 6 or more (Silver member flight count) | 0.9 |
| Any other passenger | — | 1 |

The membership's status and its tier's upgrade priority rank are read from the Summit membership record and the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program tier terms; the flight accruals are the flight accrual entries in the member's Summit activity history dated within the last 12 months.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Membership | Rank | Flight accruals | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active | 3 | 8 | 0.8 |
| Active | 4 | 7 | 1 |
| Active | 5 | 6 | 0.9 |
| Active | 5 | 5 | 1 |
| Active | 6 | 20 | 1 |
| Not active | 2 | 15 | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A First upgrade price of 310 dollars with an upgrade member rate of 0.9 becomes 279.00 dollars.
